# Bloom

## What it is
Plant care reminders: add your houseplants, and Bloom tells you when each needs water, food or a new pot.

## Who it's for
People who own a few houseplants and keep forgetting to water them; many are new to plants.

## Platform
A React web app, phone first.

## Brand
Greens are welcome but not required. No logo or fonts yet.

## Feel
Playful, fresh, gentle, reassuring.

## Apps they like
Duolingo's encouraging tone, and Headspace's soft calm.

## First screens
A welcome page, sign-in, and a home screen with today's plant tasks.

## Content

Show exactly this content on these screens: no more items, no fewer, no other actions. How it looks and is laid out is up to you.

### Welcome (/)

- Page title: Bloom
- Main line: Happy plants, no guesswork.
- Supporting line: Add your houseplants and Bloom tells you when each one needs water, food or a new pot.
- Three short points:
  - Gentle reminders, never nagging
  - Simple care tips if you're new to plants
  - Every plant's next task in one place
- Button: Get started
- Line: Already have an account? with the link: Sign in

### Sign in (/sign-in)

- Title: Welcome back
- Helper line: Sign in to see what your plants need today.
- Field: Email (type: email)
- Field: Password (type: password)
- Button: Sign in
- Link: Forgot password?
- Line: New to Bloom? with the link: Create an account
